description: This file appears to be a PHP source file for the nusoap library, containing class definitions (nusoap_base, nusoap_fault) and functions related to SOAP web services, including serialization, error handling, and namespace management.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: A base class providing core functionality for the nusoap SOAP library, including serialization, namespace management, debugging, and error handling.

classes.name: nusoap_fault
classes.description: Represents a SOAP fault message, used for error reporting within the nusoap framework.

classes.name: nusoap_xmlschema
classes.description: A class for parsing XML Schema definitions, allowing access to schema components such as types, elements, and attributes, and supporting schema serialization.

classes.name: soapval
classes.description: A class representing a SOAP value with associated XML element name, type, namespace, and attributes, supporting serialization and decoding.

classes.name: nusoap_server
classes.description: Allows creation of a SOAP server capable of receiving requests, invoking registered functions or class methods, and returning responses. Handles WSDL configuration, request parsing, method invocation, and response serialization.

classes.name: wsdl
classes.description: Handles WSDL parsing, generation, and management for the SOAP services, including building schema components, operations, messages, and import handling.

classes.name: nusoap_client
classes.description: A class for creating SOAP clients for invoking remote SOAP services, supporting WSDL parsing, transport over HTTP/HTTPS, headers, cookies, and proxy configurations.

classes.name: nusoap_proxy
classes.description: A dynamically generated proxy class for WSDL-based SOAP services, allowing method calls to be directly invoked as PHP methods.

classes.name: soap_parser
classes.description: A class for parsing incoming SOAP responses and messages, extracting headers, body, and faults.
